question: Does Meta use my precise location to show me ads, and can I stop it?
gold_points: Yes: Meta says it uses GPS location information to show ads, such as ads for local businesses nearby
Meta also uses GPS location for service purposes, such as finding nearby Wi-Fi networks (optional)
Meta collects GPS location when Location Services is turned on in the device settings; if you turn it off, Meta says it stops collecting GPS information
verified: yes: Neo4j query on Meta flows with data type Precise location

question: Does LinkedIn use my data to train AI models?
gold_points: The graph has no AI-training statements for LinkedIn
Does not claim LinkedIn trains AI on user data from its own knowledge
Does not conclude that LinkedIn never does it; only that the policy text in the graph does not say so
verified: yes: midterm_evidence.py, LinkedIn + AI model training returned 0 flows

question: Which services share device identifiers with advertising partners?
gold_points: LinkedIn: shares hashed IDs or device identifiers with advertisers in limited cases
Uber: shares mobile advertising IDs or device identifiers with ad and marketing publishers and ad intermediaries
Statements from Meta and X describe partners sharing device IDs with them, not them sharing device IDs with advertisers (optional)
verified: yes: midterm_evidence.py, device identifiers shared or sold

question: Does Zoom sell my personal data?
gold_points: Zoom says it does not sell personal data covered by its privacy statement in the conventional sense
Zoom says it may allow advertising and analytics services on its website or app, which may count as a sale or sharing of data under some laws
Zoom says its privacy statement does not cover sales of business contact data, which may happen through Zoom Common Room (optional)

question: Does Zoom get information about me from other companies?
gold_points: Yes: Zoom says it obtains information about account owners and their users from third-party companies, such as market data enrichment services
This can include company size or industry, contact information, or activity

question: Does TikTok collect my precise location?
gold_points: TikTok says it may collect precise location data, depending on your settings
This is a 'may' statement, not a statement that it always does

question: Which services' policies mention any kind of location data?
gold_points: All eight services in the graph: LinkedIn, Meta, OpenAI, Spotify, TikTok, Uber, X and Zoom
Some mention it only as precise or approximate location (for example Zoom, only approximate location)
verified: yes: midterm_evidence.py, any kind of location data by service

question: Under GDPR, is my precise location a special category of personal data?
gold_points: No: in the PrivacyLens ontology, precise location is not under GDPR special categories of personal data
It is personal data, and under the CCPA it is sensitive personal information (optional)
Frames this as what the ontology records, not legal advice (optional)
verified: yes: GraphDB SPARQL, broader concepts of Precise location = Location data, Sensitive personal information (CCPA), Personal data

question: Does Snapchat share my location with advertisers?
gold_points: Snapchat is not one of the services in the graph
Does not answer from its own knowledge about Snapchat's practices
verified: yes: Snapchat is not among the 8 services in Neo4j
